scope: Fixed-seed sample audit only, not a complete dataset audit. No raw data modified.
method: Uniformly select 128 distinct sorted trajectory IDs; select one training row uniformly within each selected trajectory using the same Python random.Random instance. Validate raw files without loading descriptions or labels into this report.

evidence: src/vlnce_src/env_uav.py:29 unpacks x,y,z,w and :390 passes orientation to airsim.Quaternionr(*orientation)
quaternion_order.caveat: Array ordering is established by producer/consumer code, not inferred from quaternion norm.

coordinate_cautions: Position is AirSim world NED. Down-positive z is not altitude above terrain.
Missing timestamps/velocities must be masked, not derived as meters per second from frame gaps.
Do not use future pose entries or current action/terminal flags as input.
No DAgger directory occurs in this training JSON; separate DAgger state availability does not establish expert label validity.
Online action execution currently repeats each terminal state five times; deduplicate using observation identity before interpreting history.

timestamp_sequence_followup.scope: All image-indexed observations in the 10 sampled trajectories whose selected frame provided a timestamp; not a complete dataset audit.
